thesis: Dayton is a city of small makers. This site reads the Miami Valley town by town, with succession and growth as its center.

signature.name: confluence
signature.summary: Three river lines (owner, business, next person) run down the page side rail and converge at the succession section
signature.description: Three drawn river lines represent the owner, the business, and the next person. They run down the page side by side through services and reviews, and meet at the succession section the way the Great Miami, Stillwater and Mad River meet at downtown Dayton.
